purpose: Compress the six-axis assumption ledger into three independent questions that can be viewed as a Cartesian product: which mathematical regime, which carrier/analytic architecture, and which physical obligation.
cartesian_product_warning: The 6 x 6 x 6 cube is a navigation grid, not a claim that all 216 combinations are coherent, equally important, or mutually exclusive. A cell records the strongest evidence found for that intersection; it never means the entire cell is solved.

axes.question: Under which rules may the mathematics reason and assert that objects exist?

keys.label: Classical standard
keys.meaning: Classical logic with ordinary ZFC-style analysis as the reference regime.
includes: unrestricted background Choice when not audited

keys.label: Weak formal base
keys.meaning: Explicit weak arithmetic or second-order systems used to calibrate proof strength.

keys.label: ZF with weakened Choice
keys.meaning: Classical set theory in which full Choice or Countable Choice is absent or isolated.

keys.label: Constructive/computable
keys.meaning: Existence requires constructive or computational content rather than classical existence alone.

keys.label: Topos/internal
keys.meaning: Objects and truth are interpreted internally in a selected topos, often with intuitionistic logic.

keys.label: Finite/discrete restriction
keys.meaning: A finite carrier, finite truncation, or finitist proposal replaces or regulates an infinite structure.
keys.warning: A finite regulator, finite carrier, and foundational rejection of actual infinity are distinct and must not be conflated.

axes.question: What mathematical object carries states, observables, fields, and evolution?

keys.label: Finite exact algebra
keys.meaning: Finite matrices, rational/integer complexes, or explicitly finite-dimensional algebraic data.

keys.label: Hilbert/operator
keys.meaning: Positive Hilbert spaces, operator domains, spectral data, and their completions.

keys.label: Krein/indefinite
keys.meaning: Indefinite inner products, fundamental symmetries, and positive companion topologies.

keys.label: Algebraic C*-system
keys.meaning: Observable algebras, states, GNS representations, nets, and algebra-first formulations.

keys.label: Smooth/PDE/distributional
keys.meaning: Manifolds, bundles, sections, Sobolev or distribution spaces, differential operators, and Green theory.

keys.label: Localic/synthetic/internal
keys.meaning: Locales, internal algebra objects, formal manifolds, and synthetic smooth structures.

axes.question: Which physical or theorem-level job must the framework actually perform?

keys.label: Kinematics/observables
keys.meaning: Define degrees of freedom, observables, commutation/phase-space structure, and allowed configurations.

keys.label: States/probability
keys.meaning: Construct states, representations, positivity, normalization, Born probabilities, or physical selection rules.

keys.label: Dynamics/propagation
keys.meaning: Supply evolution, spectra, operator domains, equations of motion, causal propagation, or Green operators.

keys.label: Gauge/BV/cohomology
keys.meaning: Handle gauge symmetry, BRST/BV complexes, residual cohomology, pairings, and gauge independence.

keys.label: Interactions/renormalization/QME
keys.meaning: Construct interacting products, classify counterterms/anomalies, renormalize, and restore the quantum master equation.

keys.label: Reconstruction/limits
keys.meaning: Derive the formalism from physical postulates or prove comparison, continuum-limit, empirical, or interpretation theorems.

cell_statuses.label: Local result
cell_statuses.meaning: A bounded repository result or dependency audit occupies this intersection. The surrounding cell remains broader than the result.

cell_statuses.label: Literature result
cell_statuses.meaning: A reviewed source directly treats this intersection within its declared scope, but it has not been transferred to the Weyl programme.

cell_statuses.label: Pieces only
cell_statuses.meaning: Relevant ingredients exist on two or three axes, but the reviewed work does not compose them into one result.

cell_statuses.label: Priority gap
cell_statuses.meaning: The intersection is meaningful and important to this programme, but no adequate result is present in the reviewed corpus or repository.

cell_statuses.label: Not mapped
cell_statuses.meaning: This pass has not assessed the intersection; it is not a claim that the combination is impossible or uninteresting.

cells.boundary: The full orbit algebra and AQFT net are not certified.

cells.boundary: No thermodynamic or dynamically selected physical state is proved.

cells.summary: A point-norm continuous free automorphism group exists on the explicit unitized compact algebra in ZF.
cells.boundary: Nonlinear/full-orbit Bateman-Turok dynamics, local normality, and interacting evolution remain open.

cells.summary: Choice strength of normally hyperbolic existence, Sobolev completion, and causal Green theory is unknown.

cells.boundary: Classical rigorous PDE is not automatically constructive PDE.

cells.boundary: Constructive Hilbert propositions do not supply gauge cohomology.

cells.summary: No constructive microlocal renormalization/QME chain is present.
cells.boundary: This is a missing programme, not a no-go theorem.

cells.summary: Operational and computability ingredients exist, but no shared constructive reversal joins them.
cells.boundary: A computability classification is not a reverse-mathematical or physical implication.

cells.boundary: No Weyl field theory or empirical superiority follows.

cells.boundary: Logical truth values and physical probabilities must not be conflated.

cells.boundary: A localic spectrum is not causal evolution.

cells.summary: No internal Weyl BV complex or external/internal cohomology comparison exists.

cells.summary: Internal anomaly classification, renormalized products, and QME restoration are absent.

cells.summary: No external comparison theorem states which physical predictions an internal construction preserves.
cells.boundary: Internal reformulation is not empirical equivalence.

cells.summary: Synthetic differential geometry supports formal manifolds and intuitionistic classical Einstein equations.
cells.boundary: No distributional causal QFT or Green-operator theorem is supplied.

cells.summary: Synthetic smooth geometry has not been joined to internal BV/BRST machinery.

cells.summary: One finite-dimensional reconstruction step has a representation-sensitive logical audit.
cells.boundary: No full reconstruction or continuum limit.

cells.summary: Finite Krein truncations have explicit sign, involution, and positivity witnesses.

missing_faces.label: Weak foundations x continuum analysis
missing_faces.why: This face contains Green existence, distribution theory, continuum BV, microlocal renormalization, and QME strength. It is the largest foundational blind spot with direct physical leverage.

missing_faces.label: Nonstandard carriers x physical probability
missing_faces.why: Carrier existence, positivity, GNS, internal valuations, and physical state selection are repeatedly conflated; the cube shows where only pieces exist.

missing_faces.label: Constructive/internal mathematics x gauge quantum field theory
missing_faces.why: Constructive QM, localic spectra, and synthetic GR exist separately, while BV, distributions, anomalies, renormalization, and QME at their intersection are missing.

missing_faces.label: Finite/discrete x continuum comparison
missing_faces.why: Finite kinematics and exact cutoffs exist, but controlled comparison maps, error bounds, and continuum dynamics do not.

missing_faces.label: Physical postulates x foundational reversals
missing_faces.why: A physical-looking axiom has not yet been encoded over a common base and reversed to a mathematical existence principle.

checks: three axes with six unique keys each

does_not_establish: that the three grouped axes replace the detailed six-axis ledger
that all 216 combinations are mathematically coherent
that an unmapped cell is empty in the world literature
that a literature result transfers to Weyl gravity
that a local result solves its whole cube cell
a new Lorentzian or quantum claim
